title: [Master] Different actions doesn't sync through and receive error sporadic (v3+WS)
body:
AAPS / AAPSClient 3.2.0.1
Build: aeed6e2083-2023.10.24
Nightscout version: Master: 15.0.1
GIT-Commit: f46f869c63b3e09f9895c4b99bf596942f5a013c

Bolus from AAPS calc / QW or AAPS wear calc / QW. This instance at 00:47 from wear bolus calc. Sync to NS OK. but not to AAPSClient. Error message in NSCV3-tab I have not seen before. Now time is 01:04 and it still not synced to AAPSClient. Thus wrong carb + IOB in AAPSClient.

Edit: Seem to be any action. tried to delete treatments in AAPS. Then same error message occurred in AASPClient with no sync of deletion.

Happend a few times although bit sporadic, attaching logs and screenshots from both AAPS and AAPSClient.

comments.body: Tried updating to RC2 or a later dev version I have tested alot with with no errors earlier. And same ERROR (status 400 message parameter limit out of tolerance) is appearing there also now.
I'm using ns.10be.de, and when selecting NS Dev (15.0.2) im not able to reproduce it. But if I redeploy Master (15.0.1) error reappear pretty fast.

this was a bug in setting in 10be.de
some parameter must adjust

@olorinmaia please try it again with master.
I have patched the lib/api3/generic/collection.js and lib/api3/index.js because it doesnt use the API3_MAX_LIMIT from the my.env on our side (it is in), so i rewrite it to env.API3_MAX_LIMIT.
@MilosKozak & @zehnBE . Thanks for looking into this. I redeployed NS15-master after fix on 10be.de and no errors in nscv3 log. Closing issue.
Had a similar issue - in my case it was fixed by the provider by updating to Nightscout >= 15.0.7
